exact_target: For every SiteProfile P and x,y in the existing regular Hilbert space: (x,y) in graph(regularPositiveGenerator P) iff almost everywhere xi, (V.symm y)(xi) = exp(-2*pi*xi) smul (V.symm x)(xi), with V=regularSpectralCoordinates P. No new Hilbert space, graph, multiplier, Fourier transform or generator. Exact identification needed by regular_unitary_positive_generator / future imaginary powers.

providers.name: resolvent_graph_equation
providers.statement:
theorem resolvent_graph_equation (R : H →L[ℂ] H) (hi : Function.Injective R) (x y : H) :
    (x,y) ∈ (resolventGraphOperator R hi).graph ↔ (1-R) x = R y

providers.name: realScalarMultiplier_ae
providers.statement:
theorem realScalarMultiplier_ae (g : ℝ → ℝ) (hg : Continuous g)
    (h0 : ∀ s, 0 ≤ g s) (h1 : ∀ s, g s ≤ 1) (f : RegularHilbert H) :
    realScalarMultiplier g hg h0 h1 f =ᵐ[volume] fun s => (g s : ℂ) • f s

providers.name: sigmoid_mul_rexp_neg
providers.statement: lemma sigmoid_mul_rexp_neg (x : ℝ) : sigmoid x * exp (-x) = sigmoid (-x)

providers.name: sigmoid_neg
providers.statement: lemma sigmoid_neg (x : ℝ) : sigmoid (-x) = 1 - sigmoid x

providers.name: conjStarAlgEquiv_apply_apply
providers.statement:
@[simp] lemma conjStarAlgEquiv_apply_apply (e : H ≃ₗᵢ[𝕜] K) (x : H →L[𝕜] H) (y : K) :
    e.conjStarAlgEquiv x y = e (x (e.symm y))
